synth.notes:
Two mirror axes on a 3x3 block grid: H is a band of rows at block row ah, V is a strip of columns at block col av. A5 cycles the selection H -> V -> pieces, with pieces sorted by bbox (min x, min y).
A1/A2 move H or the selected piece in x; A3/A4 move V or the piece in y. Pieces are blocked by bounds and other pieces; axes pass under pieces.
Pieces mirror across V as visible gray reflections. Mirrors across H, or across both axes, are invisible erasers (-1 ring, see-through centre).
NEW (step 268): a piece overlapping the H row gets an INVISIBLE V-mirror. Removing this rule fails only step 268.
Each frame is composited per block (piece>vis>inv>target>V>H walls) then re-extracted by colour. Stateless. Piece cycle order beyond what was observed is unconfirmed.
